meta.name: Mi Miedo Canal
meta.description:
Here you'll find the best horror and science fiction films from Mexico and the Spanish-speaking world, a FAST channel with the most chilling and terrifying stories, Mi Miedo, a channel with one of the most popular genres in streaming and AVOD.

Shows: Buenas Noches, Dijo La Señorita Pájaro, El Extraño Detras De La Puerta, 2021 La Peste (Renaceremos de Nuestras Cenizas), 48 Horas de Terror, 72 Horas Para Morir
Available on: The Roku Channel
